format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-alert-bar id="many"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "swap", "level": "warning", "text": "Подкачка занята на 92%: серверу не хватает памяти, сайты замедляются.", "source": "Сервер", "time": "2026-10-27T08:55:00Z", "action": {"label": "Посмотреть память", "href": "#memory"}, "acknowledge": {"label": "Прочитано"}}, {"id": "backup", "level": "warning", "text": "Последняя копия demo-owned.test не удалась.", "source": "Сайт demo-owned.test", "time": "2026-10-27T00:30:00Z", "action": {"label": "Открыть копии", "href": "#backups"}, "acknowledge": {"label": "Прочитано"}}, {"id": "disk", "level": "error", "text": "Диск заполнен на 98%: сайты перестанут сохранять файлы и базы.", "source": "Сервер", "time": "2026-10-27T08:58:00Z", "action": {"label": "Освободить место", "href": "#disk"}}, {"id": "down", "level": "error", "text": "demo-php.test не отвечает уже 12 минут.", "source": "Сайт demo-php.test", "time": "2026-10-27T08:48:00Z", "action": {"label": "Открыть сайт", "href": "#site"}, "acknowledge": {"label": "Прочитано"}}, {"id": "cert", "level": "warning", "text": "Сертификат demo-static.test истекает через 6 дней.", "source": "Сайт demo-static.test", "action": {"label": "Продлить", "href": "#cert"}}]}</script></sf-alert-bar>

<sf-alert-bar id="one"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "backup", "level": "warning", "text": "Последняя копия demo-owned.test не удалась.", "source": "Сайт demo-owned.test", "time": "2026-10-27T00:30:00Z", "action": {"label": "Открыть копии", "href": "#backups"}, "acknowledge": {"label": "Прочитано"}}]}</script></sf-alert-bar>

<sf-alert-bar id="info"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "update", "level": "info", "text": "Доступна новая версия панели 0.3.1.", "source": "Обновление", "action": {"label": "Посмотреть", "href": "#update"}}]}</script></sf-alert-bar>

<sf-alert-bar id="danger"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "disk", "level": "error", "text": "Диск заполнен на 98%: сайты перестанут сохранять файлы и базы.", "source": "Сервер", "time": "2026-10-27T08:58:00Z", "action": {"label": "Освободить место", "href": "#disk"}}, {"id": "backup", "level": "warning", "text": "Последняя копия demo-owned.test не удалась.", "source": "Сайт demo-owned.test", "time": "2026-10-27T00:30:00Z", "action": {"label": "Открыть копии", "href": "#backups"}, "acknowledge": {"label": "Прочитано"}}]}</script></sf-alert-bar>

probes.title: the items are sorted error, warning, info, the newest first; the bar takes the first one's colour and shows it, with no paging arrows
probes.covers: settings.items, host-states data-level, accessibility.role region, settings.label

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#many'); const root = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-alert-bar'); return el.getAttribute('data-level') === 'error' && root.getAttribute('role') === 'region' && root.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Важные уведомления' && el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-message').textContent.includes('Диск заполнен') && !el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-pager, .sf-alert-bar-prev, .sf-alert-bar-next, .sf-alert-bar-position') && getComputedStyle(el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-row')).backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; })()

probes.title: several items: the most serious is shown with no arrows; the action is tonal surface, acknowledge and «Все 5» ghost (C114 (3), AA-15)

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#many'); const all = el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-all'); const action = el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-row .sf-alert-bar-action'); const looks = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-alert-bar-row sf-button, .sf-alert-bar-row sf-button-icon')].map((one) => one.getAttribute('appearance')); return !el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-pager') && all.getAttribute('appearance') === 'ghost' && action.getAttribute('appearance') === 'tonal' && looks.filter((look) => look !== 'ghost').length === 1 && all.textContent.includes('Все 5'); })()

probes.title: «Все 5» opens the list of all under the bar, each item with its own controls; Escape closes it and returns focus to the toggle
probes.covers: the list, keyboard Escape, accessibility expanded

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#many'); const list = el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-list'); const toggle = el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-all button'); return list && list.querySelectorAll(':scope > li').length === 5 && toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && toggle.getAttribute('aria-controls') === list.id && toggle.textContent.includes('Свернуть список') && list.querySelectorAll('.sf-alert-bar-item[data-level="error"] .sf-alert-bar-item-close').length === 0 && list.querySelectorAll('.sf-alert-bar-item[data-level="warning"] .sf-alert-bar-item-close').length === 3; })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#many'); return !el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-list') && document.activeElement === el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-all button') && document.activeElement.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false'; })()

probes.title: closing a warning asks sf-alert-bar-close with hide day; not cancelled, the item leaves at once and focus stays in the bar
closing an info item asks hide always; a page that cancels it keeps the item
an error item has no close: its button minimizes the bar to a strip that keeps the count; the strip expands it again

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#danger'); const strip = el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-strip'); return strip && strip.textContent.includes('Важных уведомлений: 2') && el.hasAttribute('data-minimized') && el.minimized === true && document.activeElement === strip; })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#danger'); return !!el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-row') && !el.hasAttribute('data-minimized') && el.minimized === false; })()

probes.title: acknowledge («Прочитано») asks sf-alert-bar-acknowledge with the id; the item leaves the bar and its list

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#many'); return el.querySelectorAll('.sf-alert-bar-list > li').length === 4 && !el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-item[data-id="down"]'); })()

probes.title: the action link asks sf-alert-bar-navigate with id and href; a page that cancels it stays
the first list is not read out; a new error item later is spoken in role alert, a new warning in role status, and a minimized bar expands for a new error

steps.script: (document.querySelector('#live').items = [{id: 'c', level: 'error', text: 'Беда'}, {id: 'd', level: 'error', text: 'Новая беда'}], true)
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#live'); return el.querySelector('[role=alert]').textContent.trim() === 'Ошибка: Новая беда' && !!el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-row') && el.minimized === false; })()

probes.title: close(id) closes a warning with reason api and refuses an error item and an unknown id
up to 38rem the icon, the text and the close share the first line, the actions go under the text from its start, «Все 3» at the end

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#narrow'); const r = (s) => el.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect(); const icon = r('.sf-alert-bar-row > .sf-alert-bar-icon'); const text = r('.sf-alert-bar-text'); const end = r('.sf-alert-bar-row > .sf-alert-bar-minimize > button'); const actions = r('.sf-alert-bar-actions'); const all = r('.sf-alert-bar-all > button'); const bar = r('.sf-alert-bar-row'); const first = r('.sf-alert-bar-actions > sf-button > :is(a, button)'); return !el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-pager') && Math.abs(first.left - text.left) < 1 && icon.top < text.bottom && end.top < text.bottom && actions.top >= text.bottom - 1 && Math.abs(all.right - (bar.right - parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-row')).paddingRight))) < 1.5; })()

probes.title: in English the words are the page language's

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#en'); return el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-alert-bar').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Important notices' && el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-all').textContent.includes('All 2') && el.querySelector('.sf-alert-bar-close button').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Hide for a day'; })()
